name: consensus_score
description: Quality-weighted consensus across the 4 sub-models on the same rank scale as the sub-models. Calibrated against a reference library of 50K drug-like molecules so that a score of 0.65 is better than 99% of them. Recommended threshold: 0.65.

name: chembl_single_point_0
description: Probability from sub-model trained on ChEMBL single-point signal-based pool of 10 assays (775 compounds). Recommended threshold: 0.65.

name: chembl_single_point_1
description: Probability from sub-model trained on ChEMBL single-point signal-based pool of 9 assays (449 compounds). Recommended threshold: 0.65.

name: chembl_single_point_2
description: Probability from sub-model trained on ChEMBL single-point signal-based pool of 8 assays (329 compounds). Recommended threshold: 0.65.

name: chembl_dose_response_0
description: Probability from sub-model trained on ChEMBL dose-response signal-based pool of 16 assays (528 compounds; incl. 103 added negatives). Recommended threshold: 0.65.
